summary: N2 thunks and wrappers: a block-device layer whose public entry points are jump thunks, constant-argument forwarders, argument-shuffling legacy wrappers, container-pointer adaptors, ops-table and hook indirections. v2 retargets exactly one forwarder; v3 changes an implementation body behind unchanged thunks, retargets one adaptor member and adds one more jump thunk.

pairs.intent: A public forwarder is retargeted: blk_read now jumps to blk_read_sync instead of blk_read_cached. Machine-wise it is still one jmp and only the relocation target differs, so a matcher that masks relocations or compares raw bytes sees an unchanged thunk. The other eighteen thunks look alike (jmp, add+jmp, mov+jmp, indirect jmp) and differ from each other only by their target.
